messages.text:
At 9:17 p.m. on 11 March 2011, you did not answer Ryo’s call. Fifteen years later, Tokiwa Electrics is about to be demolished. The broken wind-up frog she gave you still fits in your palm.

Choose how to begin:
1. Pocket the wind-up frog
2. Finish the diary page
3. Open the door of Tokiwa Electrics
